title: Clamp two solar panels with the right clamp at each position: end clamps at the row ends, mid clamps between
instruction: Clamp the panels to the rails.
context: Solar panels are fixed to their mounting rails with two kinds of clamp. An end clamp has a single lip and goes only at a row end, gripping one panel's outer edge; a mid clamp has a lip each side and sits in the gap between two panels, holding both. A mid clamp at a row end grips nothing on its outer side, and an end clamp in the gap holds only one panel, so in both cases a panel can lift off in the wind. Installers fit every array this way, following the mounting system makers' instructions. The instruction says only to clamp the panels; which clamp goes where must be worked out from the clamps' shapes and the positions. Done by: solar installers and roofers.
setup: A strip of grey roof (30 x 48 cm) 36 cm in front of the arm bases on the centre line carries two aluminium mounting rails (42 x 2 x 2 cm) running left to right, 31 and 41 cm out. Two blue solar panels (18 x 14 x 1.2 cm) lie on the rails side by side with a 3 cm gap on the centre line. An orange parts tray (22 x 8 cm) beside each arm, 27 cm left and 27 cm right of centre, holds two end clamps and one mid clamp at 18, 25 and 32 cm out: aluminium, a 3 x 1.2 x 1.2 cm body with a 0.4 cm lip on top, 6 cm long on a mid clamp and 3 cm long reaching toward the panels on an end clamp, and a dark 1.2 x 1.2 x 3 cm bolt head, 30 g. Also: an inverter, two cable reels and a torque wrench on the far side.
scoring: There are six clamp positions, three on each rail: at each row end, with the clamp body just outside the panel's outer edge, and in the gap between the panels. A clamp counts at a position when it stands level (tilted less than 10 degrees) and at rest on the rail with its centre within 1.2 cm of the position. A sixth for each position holding the right kind: an end clamp at a row end, a mid clamp in the gap. Scored at the end.
reset_notes: Put each clamp back on its tray mark, end clamps with their lip toward the panels; nothing is consumed.
fidelity: A small model array: panels, rails and clamps are rigid, and clamps rest on the rails instead of being bolted down, so tightening is not modelled. The scorer checks what an inspector checks: the right kind of clamp seated at each position.
